race.comment: BELISTIC MAN (9) won well at Bingara six days ago and gets weight relief here, but rises sharply from BM50 picnic grade. Finds the right race and can feature. WANTED HILLBILLY (3) ran below expectations last time at Toowoomba, finishing seventh and beaten 6 lengths starting at $5. Nicely placed to turn things around. HEROIC CHIEF (5) improved a little finishing midfield last start at Toowoomba on a soft track and is up in distance, capable of a show. KELANOA (12) mixes form but has placed 2/2 on the going. Worth including in all multiples. INATICK (2) resumes after four months with trials behind him and Les Tilley back on board. Don't underestimate.
